run_ppo_agent_benchmark: run a PPO agent benchmark evaluation with a given model checkpoint and task config
create_ppo_agent: create a PPOAgent instance with a config specifying input type and model path
reset_ppo_agent: reset the PPOAgent recurrent hidden states and masks for a new episode
act_ppo_agent: act with the PPOAgent on observations to get a navigation action decision
get_default_config: get the default Habitat config with RGB input and Gibson checkpoint path
